_comment: Substring patterns matched (case-insensitively) against each context-menu registry key NAME and its default value. CJK keywords use \uXXXX escapes so this file stays portable across code pages. Entries marked "skip": true are DOCUMENTED but deliberately NOT removed by default - edit the file if you want them gone.

vendors.note: Registered under HKLM. Key names are padded with four leading spaces.
Registers BOTH a static verb and a COM handler. Both must be removed.
Static verb under HKCU. Avoid the bare word "Thunder" - it also matches Windows' own EnhancedStorageShell.
DOCUMENTED, NOT REMOVED. OneDrive pads its key name with one leading space (" FileSyncEx"). Uncomment the patterns to include it.
